chapterTitle: Chapter 12 Structure Determination: Mass Spectrometry and Infrared Spectroscopy
title: Problem 12-6

pages.text: PROBLEM 12-6 It’s useful to develop a feeling for the amounts of energy that correspond to different parts of the electromagnetic spectrum. Calculate the energies in kJ/mol of each of the following kinds of radiation: (a) A gamma ray with λ = 5.0 × 10–11 m (b) An X ray with λ = 3.0 × 10–9 m (c) Ultraviolet light with ν = 6.0 × 1015 Hz (d) Visible light with ν = 7.0 × 1014 Hz (e) Infrared radiation with λ = 2.0 × 10–5 m (f) Microwave radiation with ν = 1.0 × 1011 Hz
